title: Artifact Slug
description: The shared identifier shape for a persisted artifact document — a flow-spec or flow-review artifact (durable, under .crucible/docs/) or a flow-testing test plan (session scratch, never committed): lowercase, hyphen-separated, matching the filename (without extension). This file defines the value domain ONLY; the naming/placement SEMANTICS live in flow-spec / flow-review / flow-testing. Referenced by co-located schemas via {"$ref": "artifact-slug.schema.json"}.
